name: aeg-d-gc-baumgardt
title: Milky Way globular clusters: light-weighted line-of-sight dispersions from the Baumgardt database, with King-model light and population mass-to-light ratios
description: Atlas re-issue of aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v1 under data standard 2.5.1 (D-083, D-084, D-099): the same light-weighted dispersions, Harris distances and luminosities and McLaughlin & van der Marel structure and population M/L as v1, with the uncertainty terms read at source in step A, confidence levels, the source's own stated choices applied (D-096; one change, M54), and systems the sources describe as being tidally disrupted recorded, not plotted (D-097 to D-099). See REPRODUCTION.md and REPRODUCTION_RESULT.md.
x_licence_status: No licence stated by the database ('If you use these profiles for your research, please give reference to the papers'); Harris catalogue free with citation; McLaughlin & van der Marel via VizieR (CDS terms). Atlas tables intended CC BY 4.0 under D-004, citing the sources. Source files not redistributed.

x_citation: Profiles: Baumgardt (2017, MNRAS 464, 2174); Baumgardt & Hilker (2018, MNRAS 478, 1520) and the papers listed on veldis.html for each dataset code (F13, L13, L15, K18, D21, C22, G22; proper motions W15, C21, H21, VB21, LI22, T22, P22). Distances and luminosities: Harris 1996, AJ 112, 1487 (2010 edition). Structure and population M/L: McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005, ApJS 161, 304. Magnitude scatter about Harris (2010): Baumgardt, Sollima & Hilker 2020, PASA 37, e046. Exclusion quotations: Baumgardt & Hilker 2018 (arXiv 1804.08359v2) l. 226–227; M54 cut: Baumgardt 2017 (arXiv 1609.08794v1) l. 586–589.
